# Duckpad 0.10.1
This patch fixes plugin panel controls and session-save failures when another Duckpad instance has advanced the recovery store.
- Press a plugin's opening shortcut again to close its panel. Repeating the command while a native panel is still opening cancels that presentation. - Restore each plugin command's last dock width, including when opened in another editor window. Native panels finish layout before restoring the divider. - Control-W cancels the active modal or sheet, then closes an active auxiliary window or the editor's plugin/preview panel. It does not close the document underneath. Command-W also dismisses an attached modal before a document. - Retry valid recovery-generation collisions and verify the current session's durable archive before quitting. Persistent storage errors remain visible after Retry and continue to prevent an unsafe exit.
App and helpers: **0.10.1 (53)**. Requires **macOS 13 or later**. Universal binaries support Apple Silicon and Intel. Existing documents, sessions, native plugin ABI and settings remain compatible. Plugins remain separate downloads; this release does not install or enable them.
## Installation
Download `Duckpad-0.10.1-universal.dmg` and drag Duckpad into Applications, or extract `Duckpad-0.10.1-universal.zip`. Verify the files against `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The signed Sparkle feed is published after the release archive is uploaded.
## Validation and limitations
Focused regression checks cover plugin command toggles, panel width restoration, pending presentation cancellation, multiple editor windows, modal-first closing, recovery collisions, termination durability and persistent retry failures.
Recovery commits remain last-writer-wins: separate running instances are not a collaborative editing session and their independent edits are not merged. Genuine corruption and storage failures still require recovery or a successful retry. Dock height follows the editor window; plugin width is remembered per command.
The default build is ad-hoc signed, without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization. Physical Intel hardware, macOS 13, live Korean IME and interactive system picker behavior were not tested for this patch.
## Release checks
- 97 focused Swift tests passed, including isolated application-modal cancellation. - Regression tests failed before the native width and Korean Control-W fixes and passed afterward. - Localization validation passed for 733 strings and four plural entries in all eight languages. - App and both helper versions are 0.10.1 (53), each with arm64 and x86_64 binaries. - App bundle resources, entitlements, hardened-runtime ad-hoc signatures and isolated Finder/Open With, security-scoped recovery/save, window-layout and XPC smoke checks passed. - Automated interactive native save-panel checks were skipped. Physical Intel hardware and macOS 13 were not exercised.
Source: merged main commit `f06874cba776f3c676ad0dc53d1895422df97f51` ([PR #64](https://github.com/namJeongwan/duckpad/pull/64)).
